title: Review: lichen-ipv6 edge cases 2026-08-16
description:
Review of rust/lichen-ipv6/src/lib.rs focused on edge cases.

## Summary
- P0: 0 findings
- P1: 1 finding (integer overflow on 32-bit)
- P2: 3 findings (error handling, missing derives)
- P3: 2 findings (dead code, documentation)

## Review Confidence
Review confidence: 15% chance of missed bug.
Least confident areas: checksum computation edge cases, heapless Vec capacity exhaustion paths.
Would raise confidence if: fuzz testing with AFL/cargo-fuzz on parsing functions.

## What Is Actually Good
- ICMPv6 checksum verification before processing (lines 866-868) prevents amplification attacks
- RFC 4861 validation for Neighbor Solicitation (multicast target, DAD source checks)
- Explicit flow_label validation (20-bit limit enforcement)
- No unsafe code (forbid(unsafe_code))
- Proper use of heapless for no_std compatibility
